moving_average_crossover.name: Moving Average Crossover
moving_average_crossover.description: Buys when the fast MA crosses above the slow MA, sells when it crosses back below

rsi_mean_reversion.name: RSI Mean Reversion
rsi_mean_reversion.description: Buys when RSI is below the oversold level, sells when it is above the overbought level

trend_following.name: Trend Following
trend_following.description: Buys a close above the previous N-day high; exits below the previous N-day low or an ATR chandelier stop
